title: Vikram and Betal: The Sharing Child

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a child who loves sweets.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a child who did not like to share.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The child did not share sweets with his friend.
scenes.image_prompt: child eating sweets alone while friend watches cartoon

scenes.text: The friend shared sweets happily later.
scenes.image_prompt: friend sharing sweets with smile cartoon

scenes.text: The child began sharing with others. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A child learned the value of sharing when his friend showed kindness. Vikram said kindness teaches kindness.
